measurements.how_measured: Visual inspection of letterforms in upper band: hollow shaded interiors, serifs, separated glyphs
measurements.statement: Top headline is a medium-weight shaded inline ornamental serif with decorated hollow interior, wide width, high detail, very wide letterspacing

measurements.how_measured: Visual inspection of middle lines between image and body: cap-height, serif feet, even spacing, centered lines
measurements.statement: Author and address lines are regular-weight small-caps serif with low stroke contrast, wide tracking, centered, about 2x body height

measurements.how_measured: Visual inspection of two bottom paragraphs: small size, bracketed serifs, regular weight, tight leading
measurements.statement: Bottom explanatory text is small regular-weight serif with low stroke contrast, normal width, tight line spacing, centered block

measurements.how_measured: Projected vertical midline and checked left-right extents of all text lines and image edges
measurements.statement: All text lines and illustration are centered on the same vertical axis; left ~15% and right ~15% of frame have no text or image

measurements.how_measured: Estimated oval vignette extents versus frame and counted ink hues outside paper off-white and black text
measurements.statement: Exactly one saturated hue (muted blue-gray) covering ~20% of frame used only on central oval vignette of castle, bridge and trees occupying central third
measurements.value: one accent hue, central vignette ~50% width

measurements.how_measured: Compared cap-height of top headline to x-height of bottom body and estimated paper without ink
measurements.statement: Largest display height : smallest body height ≈ 3 : 1; about 60% of frame is empty off-white paper with large top margin and large bottom margin

hypotheses.statement: Hierarchy works by ornament then size then centered position, reading from showy title down to image proof to attribution to fine-print explanation.
Calm authority comes from generous empty paper surrounding a single delicate centered vignette, making the image feel like precious evidence.
Tension between sharp black lettering and soft blue tonal engraving emphasizes craftsmanship and the contrast of type versus image.

relations.rule: Center every text block and the illustration on the same vertical midline with no left- or right-aligned elements.
Place a single soft vignette image in the middle third as the visual anchor, with display type above and attribution plus small explanation below.
Keep display headline cap-height about 3x body text height while stepping down through spaced small-caps for middle lines.

fragile_if_changed: Moving any text or the vignette off the central vertical axis would destroy the formal centered specimen symmetry that defines its character.

regions.label: whole page empty paper and scale

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'central blue vignette illustration'
